record.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
record.explanation: Answer A: Amritsar. Jallianwala Bagh is in Amritsar, Punjab. Reference: https://amritmahotsav.nic.in/unsung-heroes-detail.htm?169. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
